package-export.handlingRule: Producer owns public exports; consumers use only public package subpaths.

rest-query.handlingRule: Provider owns explicit response schemas and current consumer safety.

rest-command.handlingRule: Provider separates command input, state change, conflict, unavailable, and problem response.

event-stream.handlingRule: Provider owns event registry with metadata and payload schemas separated.

job-artifact.handlingRule: Provider references large artifacts and keeps summaries compact.

mcp-tool.handlingRule: Plugin owns per-tool input/output schema and projector; generic field bags are not enough.

agent-tool.handlingRule: Agent owns tool manifest and result envelope with all result branches.

dashboard-view-model.handlingRule: Dashboard owns presentation adapters only; provider fixtures remain backend truth.

diagnostic-observability.handlingRule: Producer owns stable diagnostic names, operation names, contract ids, correlation ids, and failure reason fields.

rows.title: Core public package boundary
validationCommand: Alembic/AlembicPlugin/AlembicAgent: consumer import-boundary lint and build/check
rows.artifactPolicy: Inline export summary; generated declarations and large diffs by artifactRef.
rows.fixturePolicy: Core owns public import smoke fixtures; consumers replay imports in their build/check.
rows.driftGate: Export map/API inventory diff plus consumer import-boundary lint.
rows.removalBlocker: No subpath removal before import scans prove no consumer or replacement path is connected and representative builds pass.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Do not expose internal implementation through public wildcard subpaths without D2 decision.

rows.title: Agent public package boundary
rows.artifactPolicy: Inline export summary; declaration/package pack reports by artifactRef.
rows.fixturePolicy: Agent owns public import smoke; Alembic replays imports and runtime scenarios.
rows.driftGate: Public API boundary lint plus Alembic consumer build.
rows.removalBlocker: Alembic consumer import scan and runtime scenario must pass after any replacement.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Provider credentials and hidden reasoning are sensitive and must not become ordinary package output.

rows.title: Runtime health and capability discovery
rows.artifactPolicy: Inline compact health summary; logs and state snapshots by detailRef in diagnostic context.
rows.fixturePolicy: Alembic owns health fixtures derived from Core contracts; Plugin and Dashboard replay them.
rows.driftGate: Core runtime fixture compared against Alembic route and Dashboard/Plugin normalizers.
rows.currentCompatibilityOwner: Plugin resident service and Dashboard runtime header
rows.removalBlocker: Consumers discover runtime support through this route.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Local paths are consumer-needed for local UI but must not leak into ordinary MCP business output.

rows.title: Project runtime control
rows.artifactPolicy: Inline state summary; diagnostics/log paths by detailRef.
rows.fixturePolicy: Alembic owns route fixtures; Dashboard and Plugin replay source-of-truth snapshots.
rows.driftGate: Route fixture plus Dashboard source-of-truth normalization test.
rows.currentCompatibilityOwner: Dashboard project runtime selector and Plugin dashboard handoff
rows.removalBlocker: Runtime switching/open-dashboard UI and Plugin handoff depend on it.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Project roots are local consumer-needed fields; ordinary remote/public output must summarize or ref.

rows.title: ProjectScope contract
rows.artifactPolicy: Inline summary; registry snapshots by artifactRef.
rows.fixturePolicy: Provider route fixtures and Dashboard panel samples.
rows.driftGate: Core ProjectScope fixture against Dashboard normalizer and Plugin client.
rows.currentCompatibilityOwner: Dashboard ProjectScopePanel and Plugin project-scoped tools
rows.removalBlocker: Project-scoped routing and UI need this capability.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Local path fields are local consumer-needed and should not leak into public MCP outputs.

rows.title: Jobs command surface
rows.artifactPolicy: Compact job summary inline; reports/logs/snapshots via artifactRef/detailRef.
rows.fixturePolicy: Alembic owns job route fixtures and real bootstrap/rescan reports; Plugin/Dashboard replay.
rows.driftGate: Job route fixture plus Plugin/Dashboard consumer tests.
rows.currentCompatibilityOwner: Plugin codex-local tools and Dashboard JobsView
rows.removalBlocker: Job orchestration is a primary runtime workflow.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Logs/reports must be refs when large or diagnostic.

rows.title: Job process events
rows.artifactPolicy: Developer-facing events inline; raw-provider/secret/hidden-reasoning hidden/transient or artifact-only.
rows.fixturePolicy: Alembic owns event fixtures; Dashboard replays event and recovery fixtures.
rows.driftGate: Event schema fixture plus socket/recovery integration.
rows.removalBlocker: D7 runtime observation and Dashboard timelines depend on durable event/recovery behavior.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Only developer-facing and non-hidden events may enter UI ordinary views.

rows.title: Job display snapshots and artifacts
rows.artifactPolicy: Snapshot manifest inline; large reports/logs/LLM IO by artifactRef with redaction.
rows.fixturePolicy: Alembic owns generated snapshot fixtures and real bootstrap/rescan artifacts.
rows.driftGate: Snapshot schema validation plus Dashboard rendering fixture.
rows.removalBlocker: Runtime verification and user-facing job evidence rely on these endpoints.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Raw LLM/provider payloads require redaction and artifact policy.

rows.title: Alembic API route surface and OpenAPI seed
validationCommand: Alembic: route-to-openapi drift check to be added in D3
rows.artifactPolicy: Route summaries inline; long reports/logs via artifact routes.
rows.fixturePolicy: Alembic owns OpenAPI and route fixtures; consumers replay selected provider fixtures.
rows.driftGate: Mounted route tree to OpenAPI/fixture drift check.
rows.removalBlocker: D3-D6 consumers route through this tree.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Diagnostic and internal service details must stay out of ordinary response schemas.

rows.title: Decision Register
schemaSource: Plugin public tool schema and projector
rows.artifactPolicy: Decision summary inline; large evidence payloads by ref.
rows.fixturePolicy: Alembic owns route fixtures; Plugin owns MCP fixture.
rows.driftGate: Route capability plus MCP output projector fixture.
rows.removalBlocker: Durable decision-register requirement is active.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Do not synthesize plugin-local fake decisions when durable route is missing.

rows.title: Intent and work continuity
rows.artifactPolicy: Summaries inline; long histories by detailRef.
rows.fixturePolicy: Alembic route fixtures and Plugin public tool fixtures.
rows.driftGate: Public tool output-schema fixture plus route fixture.
rows.removalBlocker: Public agent workflow continuity depends on it.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Local cache must not mask durable route failure.

rows.title: MCP query and workflow tools
rows.artifactPolicy: Compact MCP summary inline; reports/snapshots by detailRef or artifactRef.
rows.fixturePolicy: Plugin owns MCP fixtures; provider route fixtures are replayed through resident clients.
rows.driftGate: MCP visible tool catalog to projector/schema registration check.
rows.currentCompatibilityOwner: Codex host and Alembic plugin skills
rows.removalBlocker: Public tool surface is the Codex integration contract.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Missing projector must fail closed and never leak raw payload.

rows.title: MCP clean output contract
rows.artifactPolicy: Short summaries inline; logs/reports/snapshots by refs.
rows.fixturePolicy: Plugin owns per-tool golden clean-output fixtures.
rows.driftGate: Every visible tool has projector/schema and forbidden-key checks.
rows.removalBlocker: Clean-output contract is current accepted MCP contract.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Internal, sensitive, and unrelated derived fields must not appear in ordinary outputs.

rows.title: Codex-local runtime tools
capabilityDiscovery: tools/list filtered by visible tool policy and project root
rows.artifactPolicy: Summaries inline; daemon logs/status snapshots by detailRef.
rows.fixturePolicy: Plugin owns codex-local smoke fixtures and real installed-plugin probes.
rows.driftGate: Codex-local visible tools require policy, handler, and projector.
rows.removalBlocker: No public tool owns local plugin lifecycle.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Diagnostics may contain local details and must stay scoped to diagnostic tools.

rows.title: Resident service client and capability routing
transport: local HTTP to Alembic daemon/resident runtime
rows.artifactPolicy: Summaries inline; route logs by detailRef.
rows.fixturePolicy: Plugin owns resident status/result/search/job/dashboard fixtures.
rows.driftGate: Capability-check fixture against real tool routing.
rows.removalBlocker: All MCP provider calls need route and capability checks.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Fallback must be visible and must not silently mask unavailable provider.

rows.title: Agent tool runtime core
rows.artifactPolicy: Small result text/data inline; artifacts and resources by refs.
rows.fixturePolicy: Agent owns router/result branch fixtures; Alembic replays runtime scenarios.
rows.driftGate: Package API plus Alembic consumer integration test.
rows.removalBlocker: Alembic must prove it uses package route for active tools.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Secrets and internal tool context must not appear in ordinary output.

rows.title: Agent AI provider and gateway
rows.artifactPolicy: Summaries inline only when developer-facing; raw provider payload hidden or redacted artifact.
rows.fixturePolicy: Agent owns provider/gateway fixtures; Alembic replays AI route scenarios.
rows.driftGate: Provider/gateway tests plus Alembic route scenario.
rows.removalBlocker: AI workflow must preserve provider, gateway, token usage, and error behavior.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: API keys and hidden reasoning are sensitive and never ordinary output.

rows.title: Agent runtime boundary manifest
rows.artifactPolicy: Inline manifest summary.
rows.fixturePolicy: Agent owns manifest import fixtures.
rows.driftGate: Manifest versus package exports and Alembic adapter import check.
rows.removalBlocker: Boundary map is needed to prevent ownership drift during cleanup.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Ownership metadata is public; runtime internals stay in owning packages.

rows.title: Dashboard runtime DTOs and normalizers
validationCommand: Alembic: provider fixture generation in D3
rows.artifactPolicy: UI summaries inline; artifact download refs for job evidence.
rows.fixturePolicy: Alembic owns provider fixtures; Dashboard replays them in contract tests.
rows.driftGate: Dashboard fixture generated from Alembic/Core sample responses.
rows.removalBlocker: UI must keep rendering runtime states and job evidence.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Diagnostic extra fields stay in diagnostic panels, not ordinary UI fields.

rows.title: Dashboard job and socket consumers
rows.providerTruth: Alembic event producers and job routes
validationCommand: Alembic: event fixture/replay tests in D3
rows.artifactPolicy: Event summaries inline; detailed job artifacts by refs.
rows.fixturePolicy: Provider owns event fixtures; Dashboard owns hook replay tests.
rows.driftGate: Emitted event names versus hook listeners check.
rows.removalBlocker: Live Dashboard UX depends on these event names.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Socket payloads must follow backend exposure classes and event registry.

rows.title: Guard, rules, violations, and code review surfaces
rows.artifactPolicy: Compact findings inline; full reports by artifactRef.
rows.fixturePolicy: Alembic owns guard route fixtures; Plugin/Dashboard replay.
rows.driftGate: Route output vs MCP clean output and Dashboard severity fixture.
rows.currentCompatibilityOwner: Codex plugin guard workflow and Dashboard guard UI
rows.removalBlocker: Code-review workflow depends on guard semantics.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Prompt/evaluator internals are diagnostic/internal and not public findings.

rows.title: Knowledge, recipes, wiki, candidates, modules, panorama, evolution
rows.artifactPolicy: Summaries inline; long scans/reports/snapshots by refs.
rows.fixturePolicy: Alembic owns route fixtures; Plugin/Dashboard replay selected scenarios.
rows.driftGate: Route output vs Plugin projector/schema and Dashboard fixture.
rows.currentCompatibilityOwner: Plugin public/admin tools and Dashboard knowledge views
rows.removalBlocker: Main Alembic knowledge workflows depend on these routes.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Quality/diagnostic metadata must not become success gate or ordinary output unless consumer-needed.

rows.title: File changes, signals, audit, monitoring, logs
rows.artifactPolicy: Summaries inline; logs/reports as detailRef.
rows.fixturePolicy: Alembic owns diagnostic route/socket fixtures; consumers replay diagnostic contexts.
rows.driftGate: Source-contract aliases plus Dashboard/Plugin diagnostic fixture.
rows.removalBlocker: Diagnostics are required for runtime verification and troubleshooting.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Diagnostic payloads must not leak unrelated internal/sensitive fields into ordinary outputs.

rows.title: Plugin embedded HTTP mirror
rows.artifactPolicy: Summaries inline; reports/logs by refs.
rows.fixturePolicy: Plugin owns embedded route smoke tests and compatibility matrix.
rows.driftGate: Embedded route list versus resident route compatibility matrix.
rows.removalBlocker: Prove no current plugin session requires embedded fallback or replace with connected resident route and tests.
rows.securityPropertyExposureNotes: Embedded fallback must obey the same clean-output and exposure rules as resident routing.
